original.statement: Running cert-manager with --namespace=<namespace> now limits its scope to a single namespace and disables cluster-scoped controllers.

decision.reason: [ev-ef5237d47ade] limits the fix to cert-manager "running with `--namespace=<namespace>`". The new behaviour, which keeps cert-manager to a single namespace and turns off cluster-scoped controllers, only applies when that flag is set. Installations that don't set the flag aren't described as affected. So exposure cli-flag{--namespace, set} matches the exposed state exactly, without being too broad or too narrow.
